values.note: Single site $22/night. Fees are for the summer period with full services; in early spring and late fall, when no services are provided, fees at some areas are not charged.

During the early spring and late fall when no services are provided the fees at some areas are not charged.'; page last updated May 5, 2026), read 2026-10-25

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/henry-lake-campground ('Golden Age/Interagency Senior and Access Passes accepted'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No reservations. Claim a site in person (24-hour self pay); on site you may be able to pay with the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay (download it first: cell service is limited). Campers must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10192062 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/henry-lake-campground ('24 hours – self pay'; 'allowed for a period not longer than 14 days'; 'Campers must occupy the site the first night'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Seasons of use May 15 - October 15; opens with full services the Friday before Memorial Day (subject to change). 2026: reduced services from October 15 (no water or garbage); usable until snow limits access or January 1, whichever comes first.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/henry-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use May 15 – October 15'; 'The campground is scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day'; 'Reduced services beginning October 15, 2026, no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access or January 1st, whichever is sooner.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The FS page gives 'No. of Sites: 7' and once says 7 campsites, but its second description says 11. Drive-in sites with parking spurs for tents, trailers and motor homes; one RV or camper trailer per site. No length limit posted.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/henry-lake-campground ('No. of Sites: 7'; 'a single loop campground with 7 campsites' and elsewhere 'with 11 campsites'; 'drive-in sites that can accommodate tents, trailers, and motorhomes'; 'a maximum of one RV or camper trailer and two tents per camping site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump in the camping loop.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/henry-lake-campground ('Vault in campground'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'Drinking Water-Hand Pump'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground beside Henry Lake (bass, bluegill), Bessemer Ranger District, 9 mi SW of Marenisco via FR 8100. A single loop of drive-in sites screened by natural vegetation; free concrete boat ramp with trailer parking, and a trail from the landing to an accessible fishing pier. Run by the concessionaire Camp Host, LLC. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 5, 2026) + rec.gov Scan and Pay listing (no rates, not reservable): $22 (confirmed), first-come only (confirmed), 14-day limit, 7 sites (page says 11 once), vault toilets (confirmed) + hand-pump water, Senior/Access passes accepted, season May 15 - Oct 15 with reduced services to snow/Jan 1 (added); concessionaire Camp Host, LLC. No forest alert or order for FR 8100 or Dunham Road. Note trimmed of field restatements.
